d:
Kesi sinha ko bihar ki kaee pirhiyan janti hain. ganit ki kitaben hon ya pratiyogi pariksha ki taiyari ke lie eksarsaiz buks, kesi sinha bihar ke har ghar men kisi na kisi rup men maujud rahe hain. ek achchhe tichar ke taur par kesi sinha bihar men kafi pratishthit hain. lekin ab rajniti men utre kesi sinha kya kumharar sit par bijepi ke dabadbe ko tor paenge? bibisi sanvaddata rajnish kumar ne unse unki is naee pari aur soch ko lekar vistar se bat ki.
Vidiyo: saptarishi
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
